blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Use \(dy\) to approximate \(\Delta y\) for the following functions: \(y = x^{3} - x\) when \(x\) changes from 3 to 3.02.
blocks.explanation:
Yahan asal tabdeeli \(\Delta y\) ka andaza \(dy = f'(x)\,dx\) se lagana hai.
Diya kya hai? Shuru mein \(x = 3\), aur qadam \(dx = 3.02 - 3 = 0.02\).
Find kya karna hai? \(dy\), jo \(\Delta y\) ka andaza hai.
Plan: \(f'(x)\) nikalna, \(x = 3\) par \(dy\), aur aakhir mein asal \(\Delta y\) se muqabla.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = x^{3} - x\), \(x = 3\), \(dx = \Delta x = 3.02 - 3 = 0.02\).
Maloom karna: \(dy\), \(\Delta y\) ke andaze ke taur par.
Tareeqa: \(\Delta y \approx dy = f'(x)\,dx\).

Derivative
\[f'(x) = 3x^{2} - 1\]
Kyun: power rule; \(x\) ka derivative 1.

Differential
\[dy = (3x^{2} - 1)\,dx\]
\[= (3(3)^{2} - 1)(0.02)\]
\[= 26(0.02) = 0.52\]
Yani \(\Delta y \approx 0.52\).
Kyun: \(f'(x)\) shuruaati point \(x = 3\) par lete hain, 3.02 par nahi.
Dhyan dein: \(dx = 3.02\) rakh dena ghalat hai; \(dx\) to farq hai, \(0.02\).

Asal tabdeeli se tasdeeq
\[\Delta y = f(3.02) - f(3)\]
\[= (3.02^{3} - 3.02) - (27 - 3)\]
\[= 24.523608 - 24 = 0.523608\]
Ghalti \(= 0.003608\), yani takreeban 0.69%: andaza bohat acha hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Use \(dy\) to approximate \(\Delta y\) for the following functions: \(y = \sin x + \cos x\) when \(x\) changes from \(30^\circ\) to \(29^\circ\).
blocks.explanation:
Wohi idea, magar trigonometric function ke saath.
Diya kya hai? \(x = 30^\circ\) se \(29^\circ\), yani \(\Delta x = -1^\circ\) (negative, kyun ke angle kam ho raha hai).
Sab se zaroori: \(dx\) radians mein, \(-\frac{\pi}{180}\).
Plan: \(f'(x) = \cos x - \sin x\), phir \(30^\circ\) par \(dy\), aur asal \(\Delta y\) se muqabla.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = \sin x + \cos x\), \(x = 30^\circ\), \(\Delta x = 29^\circ - 30^\circ = -1^\circ\).
Maloom karna: \(dy\), \(\Delta y\) ke andaze ke taur par.
Tareeqa: \(\Delta y \approx dy = f'(x)\,dx\), \(dx\) radians mein.

\(dx\) ko radians mein badlein
\[dx = -1^\circ = -\dfrac{\pi}{180} \approx -0.0174533\]
Kyun: \(\sin x\) aur \(\cos x\) ke derivatives sirf radians mein sahi hain.
Dhyan dein: \(dx = -1\) rakhne se jawab takreeban 57 guna bara aa jata hai.

Derivative
\[f'(x) = \cos x - \sin x\]
Kyun: \(\sin x\) ka derivative \(\cos x\), aur \(\cos x\) ka \(-\sin x\).

Differential
\[dy = (\cos 30^\circ - \sin 30^\circ)\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{180}\right)\]
\[= \left(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \dfrac{1}{2}\right)\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{180}\right)\]
\[= -\dfrac{(\sqrt{3} - 1)\pi}{360}\]
\[\approx -0.00639\]
Yani \(\Delta y \approx -0.00639\) (function thora sa kam hota hai).
Kyun: \(\sqrt{3} - 1 \approx 0.732\), aadha \(0.366\), aur \(0.366 \times 0.01745 \approx 0.00639\).

Asal tabdeeli se tasdeeq
\[\Delta y = (\sin 29^\circ + \cos 29^\circ)\]
\[\quad - (\sin 30^\circ + \cos 30^\circ)\]
\[= 1.3594293 - 1.3660254\]
\[= -0.0065961\]
Ghalti takreeban \(-0.00021\): \(dy\) ka sign aur size dono \(\Delta y\) se achhe milte hain.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Use \(dy\) to approximate \(\Delta y\) for the following functions: \(y = \dfrac{1}{x}\) when \(x = 0.5\) and \(dx = -0.1\).
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa \(x\) aur \(dx\) seedhe diye gaye hain.
\(dx = -0.1\) negative hai, yani \(x\) 0.5 se kam ho kar 0.4 ho raha hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(dy\), \(\Delta y\) ke andaze ke taur par.
Plan: \(f'(x) = -\frac{1}{x^{2}}\), phir \(x = 0.5\) par \(dy\), aur muqabla.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = \frac{1}{x}\), \(x = 0.5\), \(dx = -0.1\).
Maloom karna: \(dy\), \(\Delta y\) ke andaze ke taur par.
Tareeqa: \(\Delta y \approx dy = f'(x)\,dx\).

Derivative
\[f(x) = x^{-1}\]
\[f'(x) = -x^{-2} = -\dfrac{1}{x^{2}}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{x}\) ko \(x^{-1}\) likh kar power rule lagaya.

Differential
\[dy = -\dfrac{1}{(0.5)^{2}}(-0.1)\]
\[= -\dfrac{1}{0.25}(-0.1)\]
\[= -4(-0.1) = 0.4\]
Yani \(\Delta y \approx 0.4\).
Kyun: do minus milkar plus bante hain. Samajh mein bhi aata hai: \(x\) chhota ho to \(\frac{1}{x}\) bara hota hai.
Dhyan dein: \((0.5)^{2} = 0.25\), aur \(\frac{1}{0.25} = 4\).

Asal tabdeeli se tasdeeq
\[\Delta y = f(0.4) - f(0.5)\]
\[= 2.5 - 2 = 0.5\]
Ghalti \(= 0.1\) (20%): andaza kamzor hai, kyun ke \(dx = -0.1\), \(x = 0.5\) ke muqable mein chhota nahi (20% ki tabdeeli), aur \(\frac{1}{x}\) ka graph 0 ke qareeb tezi se murta hai.
